source_review: Both reviewers source-read only. Scalar half-cell padded bilinear truth, fsum/sqrt m/v relative-L2 norms, coordinate/model/endpoint bindings, actual-return timing and cumulative counter schemas match the producer API. Full48/source/artifact gates and all3-required medians preserve8case/24pair/48row denominators. No material source/math/schema blocker found.
numeric_scope: Ordinary numerical agreement and recorded engineering eligibility, not a physical-quality pass or verified enclosure. Criteria do not change from outcomes.
not_performed: Neither auditor nor criteria has been imported, parsed, tested or executed. No current-run artifacts, project arrays, numerical audit, PDE/optimizer, plots or compression were accessed by the reviewers while the producer was live. Only source/criteria authoring, source-file hashing and source review occurred.
failure_policy: Missing completion/manifest retains actual recorded failed/interrupted/unattempted metadata and all48 planned rows, with no array evaluation or verified credit. Any audit exception retains the planned denominator and clears all verified events/credit. Failed first producer attempt and earlier unexecuted v1 draft remain preserved.
authority: Root must independently confirm the actual v2 producer terminal before any audit execution. The explicit terminal flag, terminal-observation artifact, both expected source hashes and a fresh OUTER output are required. A source review/freeze itself does not authorize live-run reads.
limits: No independent remeasurement of wall time and no PDE/objective replay beyond checking embedded807 evidence. Intermediate vectors are hashed rather than replayable. No successful-only medians, winner/p-values,8s event imputation, new geology, student design, novelty or completed scientific goal.
